definition.name: Closed periodic TimerHandler diagnostic on native6fd

steps.name: Fetch immutable original SDK and native source preimages
steps.run:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 7d2c0f793cf4a87594eadd2d82d5798f448be34e
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 6fd19eab2c224fc31481d03de5008de4d3e4429e

steps.name: Check closed source codes exact LOG accounting and bounded stream projection
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_periodic_diagnostic -v
rustc --edition 2021 --test tools/fixtures/dotnet-periodic-console-control.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-stream-control"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-stream-control" --test-threads=1

steps.name: Derive only two diagnostic SDK sources in a separate detached checkout
steps.run:
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
git worktree add --detach "$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-source" "$GITHUB_SHA"
python3 -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-source/tools/dotnet_periodic_diagnostic.py" derive

steps.name: Install the normal captured compiler isolation boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Install normal pinned tools against the captured diagnostic SDK
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/periodic-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"
